name: King of the Cannon
desc:
Climb to the top to become the king! As the king, throw cannonballs down at people climbing to stop them!

❓More things to do:
    🏎️ Unlock cool mounts to show off
    🏝️ Explore different maps and mechanics
    💰 Collect coins to unlock mounts and other accessories
    🥇 Show off your skills on the global leaderboard
